stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class, exact counts). No Common Data Set was found on clayton.edu (only a Fact Book), so SAT total, GPA, residency and international splits are not available. College Navigator fall 2024: 1,870 applicants, 68% admitted, 40% of admitted enrolled (the admit count is not published as a number). Undergraduate enrollment 5,551 is fall 2024; student-faculty ratio 20:1 has no year label.
